verdict.rationale: Secureframe's docs show a policy template library written and approved by former auditors, plus a policy editor with attributes, AI-powered revisions and generative AI drafting. Versioning is only implied by a 'date modified' attribute, and there is no evidence of policy approval workflows or per-employee acceptance tracking. Missing for 10: policy version history, policy approval workflow, per-employee policy acceptance/attestation tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
